entries.evidence: Checked Sz(2): Fixed points of the exceptional B2 endomorphism composed with Frobenius in characteristic 2. Parameter domain: q = 2; m = 0 Order formula: 20. Simplicity: It is not simple: Sz(2) is a solvable Frobenius group of order 20. Wilson §5.3 gives Sz(2) as the Frobenius group of order 20, C₅⋊C₄ with faithful action; it is solvable, not simple. The exceptional endomorphism at m=0 is retained.

entries.evidence: Checked Tits group: The commutator subgroup of ²F₄(2), of index 2. Parameter domain: The commutator subgroup of \({}^2F_4(2)\). Order formula: 17971200. Simplicity: It is a nonabelian simple group. Wilson §5.3 establishes simplicity of the derived subgroup and index two. ATLAS Tits group heading confirms 17971200 = 2^11·3^3·5²·13. This is the separate Tits role, not an additional sporadic group.
